{{Top|leg}}
The '''Perosa tree''' was a short deciduous [[Tree/Legends|tree]] found on the Forest [[Moon/Legends|Moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The bark of this tree could be used as sustenance or as light [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. The nutritional value of Perosa "steaks", as they were called, was minuscule, but they were juicy and tender if roasted over a fire. [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] and [[Yuzzum/Legends|Yuzzums]] also used the sap of the Perosa tree as a strong adhesive for use in constructing their homes.
